purpose: Freeze one range/amount peak-timing-alignment factor, the complete 113-definition semantic library, all 111 eligible numeric comparisons, ordered no-return gates, and exactly one conditional 2019-2023 development trial before opening Campaign082 source rows or values.

candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_peak_timing_alignment_240m
candidate.formula: For exact standard bars i=0..239, r_i=log(high_i/low_i), i_range=last_argmax(r_i), i_amount=last_argmax(amount_i), score=1-abs(i_range-i_amount)/239.
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Co-arrival of the widest intrabar price-discovery interval and the largest participation burst identifies a repricing shock supported by concentrated liquidity and attention, which may persist over the next three sessions.
candidate.source_grid: Require exactly the raw 09:30 row plus all 240 standard continuous-session bars; select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 and exclude 09:30 from the factor.
candidate.normalized_index_rule: Use collapsed observation positions 0..239 in the exact standard-bar order; no clock-duration weighting and no price/return transition is formed across lunch.
candidate.range_rule: For every selected bar use float64 natural log(high/low); high and low must be finite and strictly positive with low<=high. Require the maximum log range to be strictly positive.
candidate.amount_rule: Every selected amount must be finite and nonnegative. Require the maximum amount to be strictly positive.
candidate.tie_rule: Select the last exact occurrence of the maximum independently for log range and amount. No epsilon, rounding, prominence, first-occurrence alternative, or stochastic tie break is allowed.
candidate.distance_rule: Take the absolute integer distance between the two frozen last-maximum indices and divide by exactly 239; subtract the normalized distance from one.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, source-grid mismatch, any selected nonfinite/nonpositive high or low, low>high, any selected nonfinite or negative amount, nonpositive maximum range, nonpositive maximum amount, nonfinite score, or score outside [0,1]. Never impute, smooth, clip, bucket, rank, winsorize, neutralize, or substitute another grid.
candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 numpy.log, exact numpy maximum equality, and reverse-axis argmax or an equivalent deterministic last-exact-maximum procedure. Do not endpoint-canonicalize or clip an out-of-range score.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.label_partition_rule: Both t+1 entry and t+3 exit must lie inside the same train or validation partition as the signal; purge the final three signal sessions at every boundary.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025_rule: Open once for the whole frozen campaign only after a nonzero 2019-2023 development-survivor record; classify as historically exposed stress replay, never pristine holdout.
